The '''Dune Sea Tunnel''' was a natural tunnel located in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:NC" /> The tunnel connected the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR:DST">{{TORcite|type=location|Dune Sea Tunnel|Tatooine}}</ref>
